collection.title: Mercedes-Benz SL Class Roadster 2012 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz SL Class Roadster 2012 to 2016 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses Aquablades which come in Heated and Un-Heated versions. You will need to check which version you have, if you are unsure please get in touch with us on 01299 251130 and we will help you.
